input_units: BSA percentage 0..100; log2 positive Summary.xlsx concentrations in recorded pg/ml
formula: P(recorded_grade <= k)=sigmoid(threshold[k]-sum(coefficient*input)); category probabilities are adjacent cumulative differences
decision: argmax category probability; expected grade is a secondary continuous summary
instrument_status: Recorded 0..5 grade. Exact IGA instrument identity pending; not validated vIGA-AD.
status: Exploratory target-specific refit on the current recorded clinical outcomes. PP-NRS and DLQI are separately fitted bounded continuous regressions; IGA is a six-category ordinal model with instrument identity pending. W24 is previously inspected same-cohort temporal transfer.
selection: 3-fold patient-inner MAE for continuous targets; normalized RPS for ordinal target. W24 absent from selection.
validation: 2 repeats of 5-fold patient-held-out outer validation; W24 previously inspected same-cohort temporal transfer
assay_processing: Same positive Summary.xlsx exports as EASI input; no half-min replacement; below software detection bounds can remain positive. Assay bridge not established.
